issues.title: if the x-signature-ed25519 is error，PHP will be die
issues.body:
My PHP version is 7.2. If x-signature-ed25519 is wrong, such as 2321312913, my interface will report a 502 error. Check the nginx error file, which is displayed as follows:
_2023/01/15 09:37:52 [error] 6#6: *179 recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer) while reading response header from upstream, client: 172.19.0.1, server: customer-local.com, request: "POST /api/discord/interactions HTTP/1.1", upstream: "fastcgi://172.19.0.6:9000", host: "customer-local.com"_

pullRequests.title: Set `simplito/elliptic-php` as an optional dependency
pullRequests.body:
Requiring the `discord/interactions` library means that `ext-gmp` must be installed even if interaction signatures are not being validated. Changed `simplito/elliptic-php` to be a suggested dependency and locked it at version `^1.0`.

Also removed the `composer.lock` file as it doesn't need to be version controlled for libraries (it's ignored by Composer).

This should a breaking change as `simplito/elliptic-php` won't be installed by default now.
